title: Checked-in defaults and local overrides
expected: APP_MODE defaults to development; an explicitly copied local override selects sandbox.
CI records ignored local overrides and retains checked-in configuration.

cases.name: local-override
cases.change: Copy local-override.toml.example to project/oyzu.local.toml in a disposable copy.
cases.expect: Only local scope changes; the local file stays ignored by Git.

limitations: Oyzu CLI/build/agent integration is pending; native checks do not prove policy, sandbox, cache, reporting, or release behavior.
